ideas.pitch: A mobile-first web app allowing citizens to photograph local infrastructure issues like potholes or broken streetlights, automatically tagging GPS coordinates and translating descriptions into local official languages for municipal bodies.
ideas.title: SetuScan: Regional Language Public Infrastructure Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at a beginner-friendly hybrid hackathon focused on turning local problems into practical solutions, appealing to judges looking for immediate civic utility.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight platform connecting local farmers facing crop surplus with nearby micro-enterprises and food banks, optimizing routes to minimize food waste during harvest season.
ideas.title: AgriBridge: Direct Farmer-to-Consumer Produce Surplus Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a grounded regional economic problem with a clear logistical prototype that judges can easily test and understand within a short timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered curriculum generator that builds hyper-localized, offline-accessible micro-learning roadmaps for vocational students based on available regional industries.
ideas.title: EduSetu: Low-Bandwidth Offline-First Skill Pathway Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses accessibility challenges in hybrid and tier-2 educational settings, resonating well with beginner-friendly impact criteria.

ideas.pitch: An emergency logistics prototype mapping regional blood banks and community donors to hospitals in real-time using SMS fallback notifications for areas with poor internet connectivity.
ideas.title: MedRoute: Community Blood and Resource Allocator
ideas.why_it_could_win: High emotional and practical resonance for local hackathon judges prioritizing emergency healthcare resilience.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and web dashboard simulator that tracks institutional utility usage, providing automated daily reduction targets and gamified leaderboards for student hostels.
ideas.title: CampusFlow: Smart Energy & Water Usage Monitor for Hostels
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly deployable by the hosting institution or local campuses, giving judges a tangible, ready-to-pilot real-world prototype.
